messages:
maria_rodriguez: Heads-up — nightly SAST started failing across a few repos. Root cause looks like KMS decrypt errors after last night's keystore rotation. Opening thread to draft a short runbook/playbook to avoid noisy incidents.
aj: Saw CI logs. Error: `cloudkms.projects.locations.keyRings.cryptoKeys.decrypt permission denied (403)` for `serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Any RBAC changes recently? :eyes:
toshi: I rotated the key at 02:10 UTC per rotation schedule. I updated the key version but apparently forgot to rebind the scanner SA to the new key policy. My fault — I can rollback or add binding quickly.
sec-bot: alert: `scan-runner` failed for repo `redwood-core` (workflow: nightly-sast). Error summary: `KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED` — see logs: `projects/redwood-prod/logs/cloudkms.googleapis.com%2Factivity`.
devops: Short proposal:
1) emergency-path: grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to `scanner@...` for the affected key for 1 hour via ephemeral binding.
   Example:
   ```bash
   gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/main \
     --member=serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
     --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
   ```
2) open ticket: tracker -> `SEC-` with automation from CI (if decrypt error, auto-create and tag `sast-kms`).
3) notify security oncall and eng-owner.
maria_rodriguez: +1 to ephemeral grants and automation. We must ensure audit trail for every add-iam-policy-binding and the rollback. Also add a fail-open policy for scanner: if decrypt fails due to perms (not key missing), fallback to queued re-run with a short delay so we don't block releases.
lisa_ng: We should also export Cloud Audit Logs to central bucket and filter for `protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt"` and `resource.labels.crypto_key`. That will let security correlate rotation events with scan failures.
samir_k: Draft runbook items (short):
- Triage step: check CI log for `KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED` and `principalEmail`.
- If principal is `scanner@` -> run ephemeral grant command above and attach policy change to incident ticket.
- If decrypt error shows `NOT_FOUND` -> possible key/version mismatch -> contact key owner (rotation-owner) and revert rotation or promote previous version.
- Post-incident: run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` and save to audit bucket, then update rotation checklist.
oncall-1: I'll take first responder this window. Can we add a Datadog/GCP alert with query like:
```
resource.type="k8s_cluster" AND jsonPayload.errorMessage:"KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED"
```
and route to #eng-oncall + pager. Also add a runbook link in the alert.
jenna: Also important: update pre-merge security checklist so anyone changing keystore bindings has to add `eng-security` reviewer. Add a GH CODEOWNERS line for `infra/keystore/**` -> `@eng-security`.
maria_rodriguez: Agree. Action items: Toshi to add ephemeral binding now, Devops to add CI automation to create ticket on decrypt error, Lisa to wire audit log export/filter, Jenna to send PR for CODEOWNERS, Samir to write the short runbook doc. I'll collate and push to the security runbooks page.
toshi: Adding binding now, will post confirmation and link to policy diff.
sec-bot: event: policy-binding-created (actor: toshi) — `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to `scanner@redwood-prod` — TTL: 1h. :thumbsup:
aj: After TTL expires we should verify scanner job success and ensure no lingering perms. Also consider a periodic test that simulates key rotation to validate our CI and RBAC hooks.
lisa_ng: For long-term fix: consider letting the scanner use a KMS-encrypted envelope key stored in secret manager where the scanner has limited access; rotation would be handled by secret-manager rotation hooks and reduce direct key policy edits.
samir_k: I'll draft the incident retrospective template: root cause, timeline, policy diff, who granted ephemeral access, and remediation checklist. Will include a built-in audit query snapshot.
oncall-1: Logging the incident now in the oncall tracker. I'll follow up in the ticket with timestamps.
jenna: Will open the CODEOWNERS PR and ping the infra-owner. ETA today.
maria_rodriguez: Thanks everyone. Once Samir posts runbook I'll link it from the alert and close this thread. :white_check_mark:
